title: NeoRadar system policy
description: systems/<system>/policy.json: the per-system behaviour policy. Absent means every default, which is the client's existing behaviour. Each domain adds its own section here; a section absent means that domain keeps its defaults for the selected profile.

profile.description: The named trait bundle every section resolves its defaults from. euroscope is the client's existing behaviour; eurocontrol, topsky and uk take effect as each domain's section lands. An unknown name is a load error and the system loads on defaults.
